readerQuestion: How can I make Home Assistant weekday routines skip public holidays and my own days off without disabling them by hand each time?
selectedBecause: Selected after reviewing every existing article title and all topic-brief reader questions. The September 15, 2026 Home Assistant Community discussion asks for editable normal-workday versus holiday behavior, while independent Reddit discussions and current exact-query results show recurring confusion about personal leave, holiday exclusions and tomorrow offsets. This is a broad practical local-automation setup, distinct from the existing gradual wake-up light and calendar appointment-notification owners. The contribution is a complete notification-only morning rehearsal, a three-condition decision table and explicit handling of missing calendar data; not a rewrite of the Workday reference. Community interest and search results do not establish search volume. searchReview.intent: Set up public-holiday and personal-day exceptions for a timed weekday routine, then verify the routine will skip the right dates.
searchReview.resultGap: Current exact-query web search returns solid reference documentation alongside older YAML-era answers about missing US holidays, adding the holidays library manually, date ranges and tomorrow sensors. existingCoverage.decision: All titles and existing topic briefs reviewed before selection, then relevant article bodies examined. Wake-up guide owns gradual brightening and explicitly leaves holidays manual; this page owns date eligibility, region settings and personal exceptions, linking to the ramp owner for execution. Calendar notifications owns before-appointment alerts; this guide only checks whether a dedicated days-off calendar has an active event. Weekly thermostat scheduling and Home/Away/Sleep household modes remain with their owners. Pre-draft SEO intent gate passed. Separate refresh opportunities from September 21 recovery review remain the existing IKEA, Bluetooth, leak-sensor and doorbell pages, ideally adding real device/firmware evidence. No fabricated tests, date refreshes, homepage, strategy, or existing-article changes authorized. Recent Bluetooth 19 vs 8, leak-sensor 14 vs 6 and IKEA 7 vs 0 page impressions all have zero clicks; small samples are not proof of demand or recovery.
